interests.name: In the Mood for Love
interests.description: In the Mood for Love (2000), directed by Wong Kar-wai and starring Maggie Cheung and Tony Leung Chiu-wai, is a restrained romantic drama set in 1960s Hong Kong. The story follows two neighbors who, after suspecting their spouses of mutual infidelity, develop a close but platonic companionship as they privately reconstruct the affair. Renowned for its sumptuous cinematography, meticulous framing, and recurring musical motifs, the film meditates on yearning, social constraint, memory, and regret in an art-house, period style.

interests.name: Before Sunrise

The film follows an American man and a French woman who meet on a train and spend one night roaming Vienna, talking about life, love and identity. Its elliptical, dialogue-driven approach emphasizes naturalism and the emotional intensity of a fleeting encounter, exploring themes of chance, communication and missed opportunity.
